("raised" OR "secures funding" OR "Series A" OR "Seed") AND ("growth" OR "B2B SaaS" OR "franchise" OR "healthcare") AND NOT ("internal team") -enterprise -global -inc
("names new" OR "appoints" OR "hires" OR "welcomes") AND ("Chief Marketing Officer" OR "VP of Marketing" OR "Head of Marketing" OR "Marketing Director") NOT ("promoted")

site:linkedin.com/posts ("looking for local SEO" OR "recommend Google Ads expert" OR "hiring a growth agency") -agency -clutch -top -our -portfolio -"we offer"
